audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts read Skill/Yone/Yone/Skill/Skill/Yone/Yone, which contradicts the packet chart (Skill/Gragas/Skill/Gragas/Gragas/Skill/Yone) and the whys sitting beside them: whys[1] says Gragas out-trades at 2, whys[2] calls 3 a coin-flip, whys[3] says W max plus Happy Hour wins 4-5, whys[4] calls 6 a real all-in, whys[5] says the lane resets to even after it.
audit.why: 50.7% over 712 games with Gragas owning levels 2-6 and Yone only reclaiming at two crit items.
audit.corrected: Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill, Yone — proposed as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.why: Spikes already name the right moments: Gragas level 2 (Q+W), level 6 (E-W-Q-R), first item; Yone at two crit items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Yone's E is repeatedly called 'Spirit Rewind'. Riot's name is Soul Unbound. The page also never states its cooldown, which is the single number this lane runs on (22/19/16/13/10s).
audit.why: Soul Unbound is what deletes every trade Gragas commits into — 22 seconds at rank 1 is a huge punish window, and 10 seconds at rank 5 is not. A fabricated ability name is exactly the defect class this audit exists to kill.
audit.corrected: Use Soul Unbound (E) everywhere; state 22s at rank 1 and that he is forced back to his cast position when it ends — that snap-back is your Body Slam target.

audit.why: Soul Unbound 22s at rank 1, Spirit Cleave 14s, Body Slam 14s at rank 1 make the trade rules concrete.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1. He is forced back to his cast spot when it ends; E-stun him there. - Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s. - Your E is 14s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip.

edits.after: E-W-Q into Explosive Cask is your kill window: Body Slam stuns, the empowered auto and sweetspot Q burst, and R behind him denies the Soul Unbound (22s) he'd use to snap back to safety.

edits.before: Early this is a real fight, not a free lane, and the 50.7% mirrors that. At level 1 you're a single ability with no Happy Hour yet, so don't contest his Q-dash poke. Level 2 is your first window: take Q+W, slow him with the cask and land the Drunken Rage empowered auto for a trade his early Q can't match before he has W to shield and cleave back. The key all lane is his E, Spirit Rewind, which snaps him back to where he cast it, so any time you commit before that's down he just deletes the trade and resets. Save your Body Slam as the pin, not the engage.
edits.after: Early this is a real fight, not a free lane, and the 50.7% mirrors that. At level 1 you're a single ability with no Happy Hour yet, so don't contest his Q-dash poke. Level 2 is your first window: take Q+W, slow him with the cask and land the Drunken Rage empowered auto for a trade his early Q can't match before he has W to shield and cleave back. The key all lane is his E, Soul Unbound, down 22s at rank 1, which forces him back to where he cast it — commit before that's spent and he just deletes the trade. Save Body Slam as the pin, not the engage.

edits.after: Land Body Slam to pin him for the E-W-Q burst before he Q-dashes or snaps back with Soul Unbound

notes: 'Spirit Rewind' was a fabricated name for Yone's E across early, spikes[1], whys[4] and wants — corrected to Soul Unbound. Left 'E-rewind' in late/spikes[3]/wants.foe[2] alone rather than risk length-band failures on descriptive phrasing that does not assert a false name.
